params.sql: SELECT COUNT("推奨度") AS responses, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS DOUBLE) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS DOUBLE) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors FROM data

source.inline: function main(i) { const r = Number(i.responses); const p = Number(i.promoters); const d = Number(i.detractors); if (!(r > 0)) { return { responses: 0, promoters: p, detractors: d, nps: null }; } const raw = (p - d) / r * 100; const nps = Math.sign(raw) * Math.round(Math.abs(raw)); return { responses: r, promoters: p, detractors: d, nps: nps }; }
